prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in English for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Prakash V., Ashok ji, Mahesh ji, Prakash ji.
The chat covers 16/04/26, 6:00 pm to 16/04/26, 8:00 pm. It must have exactly 26 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
16/04/26, 6:58 pm - Prakash ji: Mahesh ji, delete the transfer record right now
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- F1: chat.txt:13 at 6:48 pm vs calls.csv row 4 at 18:57 differs by 9 min (tolerance 2)
text:
16/04/26, 6:00 pm - Ashok ji: Hello everyone, good evening.
16/04/26, 6:05 pm - Prakash V.: Good evening Ashok ji.
16/04/26, 6:10 pm - Mahesh ji: Good evening all.
16/04/26, 6:15 pm - Prakash ji: Has the payment for the vendor been processed?
16/04/26, 6:20 pm - Prakash V.: I sent the account details to Mahesh ji earlier.
16/04/26, 6:25 pm - Mahesh ji: Yes, I got the details.
16/04/26, 6:30 pm - Ashok ji: Please check the invoice amount before initiating transfer.
16/04/26, 6:35 pm - Mahesh ji: Sure, checking it now.
16/04/26, 6:40 pm - Prakash V.: The amount should be around 50,000 rupees.
16/04/26, 6:45 pm - Ashok ji: Let me know once it is completed.
16/04/26, 6:50 pm - Mahesh ji: I have initiated the UPI transfer.
16/04/26, 6:55 pm - Prakash V.: Wait, did you send it to the new UPI ID?
16/04/26, 6:57 pm - Mahesh ji: Yes, the one provided in the chat earlier.
16/04/26, 6:58 pm - Prakash ji: Mahesh ji, delete the transfer record right now
16/04/26, 7:00 pm - Ashok ji: What happened? Is there an issue?
16/04/26, 7:05 pm - Prakash V.: That wasn't the official vendor ID!
16/04/26, 7:10 pm - Mahesh ji: Oh no, I already confirmed the PIN.
16/04/26, 7:15 pm - Ashok ji: Call the bank customer care immediately.
16/04/26, 7:20 pm - Prakash ji: Stop talking here, resolve it fast.
16/04/26, 7:25 pm - Mahesh ji: I am calling the bank support hotline now.
16/04/26, 7:30 pm - Prakash V.: Did you block the transaction?
16/04/26, 7:35 pm - Mahesh ji: They are putting me on hold.
16/04/26, 7:40 pm - Ashok ji: Keep trying, report it on the cyber portal too.
16/04/26, 7:45 pm - Mahesh ji: Yes, filing a formal complaint now.
16/04/26, 7:50 pm - Prakash V.: Let us know when the reference number is generated.
16/04/26, 7:55 pm - Mahesh ji: Got the ticket number, will share the updates.
